authoring: Every term and meaning authored directly from approved Russian by this agent. No pivot locale, external translator/API/model or delegated wording. Existing assembler serializes literal authored rows only.
decisions: Capitalized Gast/Gasten for supernatural threat; ordinary gasten/bezoekers distinct.
KChS transliterates КЧС, explained as Comité voor Noodsituaties; FEMA retains official-English attribution and МЧС remains the separate real agency.
Age-neutral broer/zus and source participant counts preserved; original Russian grammatical evidence retained where relevant. Unknown-sex role nouns do not assign biological or canonical gender.
Source disclosure timing and original context-specific Death zij/broer and cat кот/он retained with explicit biological uncertainty.
Zonnegelaat, Paddenstoelenman, Paddenstoelenland and Leerboek van de glimlach consistent; Gastgeest distinct from Geest van een overledene.
Enerzjeka, Bober Tsjerni and Margoro preserve fictional brands; For Rest and CR Channel unchanged.
Menu labels use infinitives; all technical keys, asset tags, numeric codes and sprite tags preserved.
